text:
jon: Heads-up: sampleapp upload failing on Pixel 8 emulator (Android 14). Repro attached. Looks like redirect + streaming combo.

tess: what error are you seeing? 400/500/timeout?

jon: okhttp follows 307 -> 302 chain then server returns 401. Logs show Authorization header present on first request, missing on second hop. Streaming body aborts.

sam: ok, that rings a bell. OkHttp strips 'Authorization' for cross-host redirects unless you repopulate it. Authenticator can help.

lucy: can you paste the client setup?

jon: minimal client in sampleapp: 

```
val client = OkHttpClient.Builder()
  .followRedirects(true)
  .followSslRedirects(true)
  .connectTimeout(20, TimeUnit.SECONDS)
  .callTimeout(3, TimeUnit.MINUTES)
  .build()

val retrofit = Retrofit.Builder()
  .baseUrl("https://ingest.example.com/")
  .client(client)
  .build()
```

jon: payload is streaming RequestBody that reads FileInputStream. First redirect to same host OK, second redirect to storage.example.com loses headers and we get 401. FileInputStream can't rewind so retry fails.

sam: yep. Two options: 1) implement java.net.Authenticator/OkHttp Authenticator to re-add auth on challenge/redirect; 2) disable followRedirects and follow manually, reusing headers and rewinding body.

tess: manual follow is painful for large files as you said. Any Kotlin/Retrofit helper for rewindable streaming?

jon: we implemented a small BufferedSource wrapper that caches up to 2MB in memory then falls back to fail on rewind. Works for small uploads only.

lucy: on emulator I also saw cookies not being sent to second host (cookie jar limited to first domain). Could be two separate causes making it flaky.

sam: add note: OkHttp 4.x kept header retention behavior slightly different vs 5.x alpha. File a matrix entry.

jon: created ticket DEVEX-5012: 'redirect chain drops auth/cookie on cross-host streaming uploads (Pixel 8, Android14)'.

devtools-bot: ticket DEVEX-5012 created and assigned to @jon; priority P2.

tess: action items: 
- add Authenticator example to sdk samples (Kotlin)
- add docs blurb about redirect semantics and streaming bodies
- add e2e test against redirecting upload server in CI matrix (emulator + device)

lucy: I'll draft the Authenticator snippet. Example: 

```
class TokenAuthenticator : Authenticator {
  override fun authenticate(route: Route?, response: Response): Request? {
    val token = tokenProvider.currentToken()
    return response.request.newBuilder()
      .header("Authorization", "Bearer $token")
      .build()
  }
}
```

sam: reminder: Authenticator is invoked for 401/407 challenges, not automatically for every redirect; for redirects you'll need followRedirects(false) + manual follow or rely on server to not change host.

jon: I'll open a small PR to sampleapp: add TokenAuthenticator sample + a manual-redirect helper that preserves headers and demonstrates buffering strategy. Keep the sample minimal to avoid onboarding friction.

tess: add a note in the onboarding doc about 'avoid multi-host redirect for streaming uploads' and mention signed upload URLs as a recommended pattern.

lucy: also flag in CHANGELOG: okhttp 5.x behavior differences for header retention. Might save others debugging time.

sam: ping me for a unit harness for rewindable RequestBody. I can mock redirect responses.

jon: repro confirmed on real Pixel 7 in lab too (less frequent than emulator). After server-side fix rolled out, errors dropped to zero. I'll link the server changelist in the ticket.

tess: thanks. once PR is up I'll review docs and add a short sample link to the Android SDK quickstart. :thumbsup:

jon: thanks everyone — closing this thread for now, will update DEVEX-5012 with PR/timeline. :partyparrot:
